rawContent: Women & girls are among those affected disproportionately by the #ClimateCrisis, especially those belonging to marginalised and discriminated communities.  Their voices are rarely heard in decision making forums. Let’s make 2020 the year this changes. #IWD2020 #EachforEqual https://t.co/gJBtifAtbU

Spearheaded by diverse & powerful women like @sostinen, the fight for #ClimateJustice is picking up speed. Will the #ClimateCrisis be the turning point in global solidarity, urging us to act, connect our struggles & triumph over the systemic inequalities that divide us? #IWD2020 https://t.co/haNnm7SqUv
